skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role and mechanisms of economic growth factors through growth models.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Role and Impact of Factors on Economic Growth
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Be able to present changes in the roles of growth factors through economic development models.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Content and Role of Factors Affecting Economic Growth
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the content and role of factors affecting economic growth.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analysis of Characteristics of Factors in Developing Countries
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze the characteristics of growth factors in the context of developing countries.

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze and evaluate the characteristics and roles of growth factors in Vietnam's recent period and propose policies to enhance their contributions to economic growth in the future.
